refill_rule.action: If missing_expected > 0, request exactly that many new chats with the identical same batch prompt. Never relaunch existing observed workers and never start a new batch until this one reaches expected_workers or a real boundary explicitly closes it.

truth_boundary: A missing worker means no durable worker was observed for one expected launch slot. The repo does not infer why the human-visible chat failed to create a beacon.
